acceptanceCriteria: A failing package in a full pull-request shard is visible on the pull request (annotation, summary or a non-required check) before the shard finishes its remaining packages.
The required go-product check and the executed package set are unchanged.
Time from run creation to the first visible failure is measured on retained failed runs before and after.
body: Found while delivering V1-0716 (2026-10-04). Affected-first ordering moves the first failing package earlier inside a shard (replay over 12 failed runs: summed package time to the first failing package median 8.7 to 4.9 minutes), but `go test` still runs every remaining package, so the check result and the log only reach the author when the shard ends. Idea: stream the `go test -json` output through a small protected filter that writes a GitHub error annotation or step-summary line as soon as a package reports fail, without changing the exit status or the package set. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-04-ci-affected-first-order.md. Hosted effect NOT_OBSERVED.
title: ci: surface the first failing package of a full shard before the shard ends
